remaining_gaps: MODE_MY_PROFILE action surfaces/icons/text/collapse/bounce now paint through an EVE Canvas renderer with source geometry; EVE still uses native hidden click/accessibility nodes, StaticLayout text and adapted NestedScrollView scroll translation.

Upstream RenderNode avatar masked shader, dynamic action insertion/deletion, complete original ProfileActionsView virtual nodes, source parent RecyclerListView physics and all cross-device matched motion/frame evidence remain missing.
Day/Night native runtime, RTL, 200% font, physical cutout and accessibility screenshots have not yet passed match-device comparison.

Original Telegram ScrimOptions/Blur3 global multi-window capture, RenderNode-backed drawable factory, liquid-glass and ViewPositionWatcher are not yet integrated; EVE now uses a source-parameterized transient current-window snapshot, stack blur and popup paint adapter.
Source-exact screenshot/animation comparison of popup on signed-in hardware with GPU cutout, Day/Night, font scale and dynamic window movement remains unverified.

Local EVE QR Canvas now implements source-traced reveal/open/close, a progressive QR build, eight palette selections, device-standard emoji patterns and touch/fling, but the original Telegram QrShareView/QrRender/QrCodeLayer particle/glass/RenderNode subsystem is not imported and visual/frame parity is unproven.

CameraX live scanner, on-device gallery decoding and flashlight support replace EVE's still-camera prototype, but Telegram's actual QrScanOverlay implementation, Telegram link processing, custom emoji pack assets, collectible gift animations and MTProto-backed themes are not included. EVE's username-only QR has a different backend contract.

Matched upstream/EVE same-device screenshots, motion traces at 60/90/120Hz, Android real camera/permission verification, Day/Night, RTL, 200% font, system inset/cutout and accessibility validation remain outstanding. Release GPL compatibility remains unapproved.
